title: Fall maple tree
text: Fall maple tree. I love this little tree!  It's so much more adorable in person!  The lights are bright, battery run (You provide the AA batteries)6 hours on 18 hours off.  I just love it.  Stands about 18" or so tall.  Beautiful Fall colors. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: FUNPENY 24 LED Lighted Fall Maple Tree, Thanksgiving Tabletop Autumn Decoration Lights Battery Operated, Maple Leaves and Acorn Tree for Indoor Home Table Harvest Decor Clearance
features: Charming Lighted Maple Tree: Pre lit with 24 LED warm white lights, the overall height is 18 inch. Equipped with 12 pcs pine cones, 12 pcs acorns and 24 pcs maple leaves. Emits a charming light.

Battery Operated & Timer: Powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries is not include). With the light timer, it will auto off for 18 hours after lighted for 6 hours. You can place it on everywhere you want, no limited by power wire.

Wonderful Fall Table Decor: Perfect maple tree is suitable for fall home decorations. Combines yellow maple leaves, abundant acorns and pine cones, it perfectly interprets the breath of autumn harvest. Ideal for home, living room, table top, fireplace, kitchen, mantel fall decorations.

High Quality: Made of high quality polyester and plastic, is durable and reusable. The light wire is covered with electrical tapes, is safety for use. The square base design makes the tree more stable.
DIY Bendable Branches: The branches is adjustable, you can change branches into any pose you like for fit other hanging ornaments decoration you need.
